findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_playground_apis, get_provider, find_operations, get_openapi, get_provider_onboarding, dispute_finding, watch_listing, request_check, check_status · Private data: get_prices, get_api, get_provider, get_tag, get_industry, find_estates, get_provider_estate, get_region, get_area, find_extensions, get_extension, tag_group_tags, find_operations, get_capability_edges, claim_listing, generate_artifact, watch_listing, request_check, export_dataset, export_stack, save_search, my_workspace, create_list, find_apis_json · Public sink: find_operations, cohort_failures, agent_readiness_dimensions, find_capabilities, gap_analysis, claim_listing, generate_artifact, submit_artifact, dispute_finding, watch_listing, request_check, export_dataset, submit_feedback · Destructive: get_prices, find_tag_groups, get_agent_readiness, save_search, list_saved_searches, run_saved_search, delete_saved_search, delete_list, find_postman.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_playground_apis, get_provider, find_operations, get_openapi, get_provider_onboarding, dispute_finding, watch_listing, request_check, check_status · Private data: get_prices, get_api, get_provider, get_tag, get_industry, find_estates, get_provider_estate, get_region, get_area, find_extensions, get_extension, tag_group_tags, find_operations, get_capability_edges, claim_listing, generate_artifact, watch_listing, request_check, export_dataset, export_stack, save_search, my_workspace, create_list, find_apis_json · Public sink: find_operations, cohort_failures, agent_readiness_dimensions, find_capabilities, gap_analysis, claim_listing, generate_artifact, submit_artifact, dispute_finding, watch_listing, request_check, export_dataset, submit_feedback · Destructive: get_prices, find_tag_groups, get_agent_readiness, save_search, list_saved_searches, run_saved_search, delete_saved_search, delete_list, find_postman

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
